acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode
alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation with 50 mM iodoacetamide
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation with 50 mM iodoacetamide
cleavage agent: digested with sequencing grade trypsin (Promega) at 37 °C for 4 h
fractionation method: Fifteen µg of each sample were run 1 cm in SDS-PAGE under non-reducing conditions
instrument: interfaced to a Thermo Fisher Q Exactive mass spectrometer
ionization type: Half of each digested sample was analysed by nano LC-MS/MS
labeling: Half of each digested sample was analysed by nano LC-MS/MS
